description: Project-authored observation and verification wording. These entries do not authorize cleaning, disconnection, inflation, restarting or other repairs. A normal observation only permits asking about the already-observed outcome.

step_1.simple_question: Without touching anything: do the visible terminals look clean, or is there a crusty deposit? If you cannot see safely, choose Not Sure.
step_1.verification_question: Based on what you have already observed, is the starting problem now resolved? Do not start the engine just to answer this question.
step_1.escalation_reason: The battery terminals need work that this guide does not approve for driver self-repair. Do not clean, tighten or disconnect them.

step_1.simple_question: Does the gauge reading match the pressure specified for your vehicle in its manual or tyre placard? If you cannot compare safely, choose Not Sure.
step_1.verification_question: Is the original tyre-pressure problem now resolved, with no remaining warning or visible tyre damage? Do not drive to test it.
step_1.escalation_reason: The pressure is outside the specified range. This guide has no approved pressure-adjustment or puncture-repair procedure.

step_1.simple_question: Using only the visible level and your owner's manual, is there sufficient washer fluid, or is it low? Choose Not Sure if the reservoir is not safely visible.
step_1.verification_question: Based on what you have already observed, is the washer problem now resolved? Do not drive to test it.
step_1.escalation_reason: The washer fluid is low. This source has no approved refill procedure for your vehicle.

step_2.instruction: Without opening or touching the pump, recall whether washer fluid sprayed normally when you last used the washer. Do not dismantle parts or operate the vehicle to answer.
step_2.simple_question: When you last used the washer, did it spray normally? If you cannot tell, choose Not Sure.
step_2.verification_question: Is the original washer problem now resolved? Do not drive to test it.
step_2.escalation_reason: The washer still needs a technical check that this guide does not approve for driver self-repair.
